description: Defines the ClientTransactionData class, a data transfer object (DTO) representing client transaction details in the Fineract project. It includes properties like id, office info, transaction type, date, currency, payment details, amount, external ID, submission date, reversal status, and payment type options. Provides a factory method for instantiation and a private constructor.

classes.name: ClientTransactionData
classes.description: A data transfer object encapsulating details of a client transaction, including identifiers, date, monetary data, payment details, and options.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate a ClientTransactionData object with specified transaction details and payment type options.
